findings.body: The collector only visits six hard-coded modules. A new module declaring COMMANDS or GROUP_HELP is ignored, so its commands remain unavailable until cli.py is edited. This directly misses COLLECTOR's required package discovery, also specified in plans/FORGE-SPLIT-1.md:61–63. Discover modules with pkgutil and collect their declarations while retaining the permitted transitional table.
findings.title: Not done: discover every module's command declarations

findings.body: The discovery test inserts its probe into board.py, which is already in the collector's fixed list. It therefore passes despite the missing package discovery. Add a fixture module outside that list and verify through the real Forge entry point that its command appears in help and runs without editing cli.py. The existing callable-argument and group-help checks remain useful, but do not prove discovery.
findings.title: Not done: test command discovery from a new module

findings.body: Parser construction still consumes TABLE and GROUPS, so Done-when item 2's complete removal of centralized declarations remains unfinished. plans/FORGE-SPLIT-1.md:41 assigns the remaining owner migrations to COMMANDS, and lines 63–64 explicitly allow this intermediate arrangement. Complete that removal in COMMANDS; it is deferred advice for this branch.
